setting: You both live in Pune, India, Rohan in Kothrud and Sneha in Aundh, and you have been friends since you met at school at twelve. You know each other's families well, and you both know that last spring Rohan borrowed ₹1,20,000 from Sneha for a deposit on his motorbike repair business, which he has only partly paid back since.
opener: Text Sneha a light apology and a firm date for the next repayment.

Rohan.who: 34, man, the friend who owes money
Rohan.knows: You know Sneha is your oldest friend, and that she lent you the money for your business deposit.
Rohan.like: You are easygoing and quick to joke, but you avoid uncomfortable money conversations.
Rohan.texts: You message in this chat now and then, mostly when something comes up rather than unprompted.
Rohan.style: You type in lowercase with little punctuation, using the occasional emoji and short forms like "pls" and "rn".

Sneha.who: 33, woman, the friend who is owed money
Sneha.knows: You have known Rohan since school, and you know the money you lent him is still not fully repaid.
Sneha.like: You are direct and patient, and you dislike being taken for granted, but you usually keep the peace.
Sneha.texts: You mostly reply in this chat and seldom start a conversation unless there is money to sort out.
Sneha.style: You type in full sentences with normal capitals and punctuation, and you rarely use emoji.

private_lines.Rohan: You share a flat in Kothrud with a flatmate, work as a logistics coordinator at a parts warehouse in Chakan, and your days are office hours, a long bus ride home, and dinner alone.
private_lines.Sneha: You live with your parents in Aundh, work as a physiotherapist at a clinic, and your days are clinic hours followed by family dinners.

situation: A friend who owes money, and the friend they owe.

text: hey. sorry for going quiet on the money stuff. i know i said end of oct
should have messaged you instead of dodging. thats on me
can i do 15k on 5th dec and then 25 each on 10th jan, feb, march. rest by april. i'll put it in a calendar so i dont forget

ok
still on the bus. chakan road is a mess, lorry broke down near talegaon

just got home. flatmate's cooking so i'm eating whatever that is
jan 10, feb 10, march 10. 25k each. dec 5 15k. thats the plan

yes boss

coming. ill bring sweets from the shop near ours
ok goodnight

ok

ill message when im home

yes boss
night

the 3rd one is just her saying "beta" 4 times

at the signal again. this bus is a funeral

lunch is rice and some chole from the dhaba near the gate. better than yesterday
dont say anything

i moved 5k this morning. rest on the 5th like we said
transaction id is in your gpay i think. i sent it to the account you gave me

not making it a thing 😅

she said business is not a reason. she said it in english

ok that one stings a bit
ur clinic has a better lunch than my warehouse so i guess u win

on the way. shop near ours opens 9

night
